prompt: How can I increase the swap size in my Ubuntu 22.04.1 LTS system?
response: To increase the swap size in Ubuntu 22.04.1 LTS, you can use the following command in the terminal: `sudo fallocate -l 4G /swapfile` to create a 4GB swap file. Then, set permissions with `sudo chmod 600 /swapfile` and make it swap space with `sudo mkswap /swapfile`. Enable it with `sudo swapon /swapfile` and check the swap usage with `free -h`.
